messages:
Anya: Putting up a fresh take on the console nav IA. Two main flows: desktop auto-expand to show the full path, mobile uses a compact pill + 'show in nav' button. Link to prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/console-nav-variantB

Priya: Love the responsive idea. Quick UX question: when a deep-link hits a nested page, should breadcrumbs always reflect the canonical hierarchy even if the nav is pillled on mobile? My vote: breadcrumbs = single source of truth.

Ethan: Breadcrumbs as canonical is fine. On mobile, the pill should show the active item label and an affordance that opens a temporary overlay nav (not full persistent nav) so we avoid layout shift. Overlay could animate from the left.

Sophie: Accessibility notes: overlay must trap focus and return focus to the pill when closed. For screen readers, when deep-link auto-expands on desktop announce "Navigation: Models expanded, 4 items". For mobile overlay announce "Navigation opened". Also provide skip link to main content so keyboard users can bypass the nav.

Leo: Implementation concern: mapping deep routes to pinned/custom groups. If someone pins a model into a 'favorites' group, deep-link should lead to that pinned context. Suggest keeping a lightweight mapping service: routePath -> navLocation (groupId, index). That can be resolved at render time.

Anya: Good call. I'll add an API: GET /ui-nav-mapping?path=/apps/1/projects/2/models/3 returns group id or fallback.

Priya: Copy micro-tweak: pill label should be "Models · xyz" not just "xyz" so people keep context. Tooltip on long names "Open in navigation" for the show affordance.

Ethan: For animation, avoid height transitions on the content area. Instead animate nav transform and fade to reduce CLS. Also debounce resize so desktop->mobile threshold doesn't reflow mid-interaction.

Sophie: A11y checklist I'll post separate but quick items: aria-expanded on desktop group, role="dialog" on overlay, focusable close, esc to close, announce nav open/close via live region, visible focus ring, readable color contrast for pill.

Design-bot: Prototype published: sidebar-pill-overlay-v1. Commit: a1b2c3.

Anya: Quick poll: which pattern for mobile: (1) pill opens overlay, (2) auto-expand in a temporary collapsible area, (3) slide-over full screen. Reply 1/2/3.

Ethan: 1

Priya: 1 (overlay feels least disruptive)

Leo: 3 for tiny phones, 1 for mid-size. Can we do breakpoint-based?

Sophie: 1 but ensure it's accessible.

Anya: Consensus leaning 1 + breakpoint for very small devices if needed. Action items: 1) Add nav-mapping API spec (Leo), 2) Dev constraints doc for animations & CLS (Ethan), 3) Accessibility acceptance criteria (Sophie), 4) Update figma with pill copy and tooltip (Priya). Hoping to get canary by next Thurs.

Priya: One more tiny thing: breadcrumbs truncation behavior. Let's use middle truncation for long project names instead of end truncation so both ends remain readable.

Ethan: Agree. Also add aria-labels exposing full names on breadcrumbs and pill.

Anya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the RFC and tag you when ready. :rocket:
